blocks.text: The digital twin follows four model-based design rules. Together they make a change to the real robot (a new motor, a heavier pack, a different gear) a parameter edit, not a model edit:

items: **One parameter source.** Every number lives in `params/param_<domain>.m`; `shaddad_params` collects them into the structure `P`, the sample times `Ts` and the variant controls `VC_*`. Models read `P`; they hold no numbers of their own.
**Generated models.** Every `.slx` file is generated by a script in `scripts/build/` and is never edited by hand. A structural change is made in the build script and the model is regenerated.

**Variants for fidelity.** Variant controls select the level of detail per domain (for example the grouped or lumped battery, the drive fidelity, the implement), so the same model serves fast system runs and detailed component studies.

**Tests on every change.** Unit benches per domain, system scenarios and the Phase 1 suite compare the model with requirements; expected values are derived from `P`, so they follow the real robot automatically.

blocks.caption: Model-based design workflow of the project: real-robot data feed the parameters, the parameters drive the generated models, tests verify them, and measurements on the robot close the calibration loop.

blocks.text: `Shaddad_System` is the top model. It references the plant (`Shaddad_Plant`: structure, drive, power and electronics hardware), the firmware of the main controller (`Shaddad_MCU`) and the BMS firmware (`Shaddad_BMS`). Inside them, subsystem references hold the component models of each domain ({fig:F01_system_top_overview.png}).

blocks.text: From the real data to the model

The re-parameterisation of 27 October 2026 touched only parameter files, three build scripts (for the new number of cell groups) and the expected values of the tests; the four-motor drive and the motor upgrade were again parameter changes, the tilt fix rebuilt one firmware unit, and the brake model of decision D64 added one Simscape component and rebuilt the brake subsystem of the drive. {tab:tab_changes} lists the changes; the previous robot is kept in `work/backup/pre_real_robot_20261027.zip`.
